company.name: Pulumi
company.description: Pulumi is a Seattle-based cloud engineering company that offers a way to build, connect, and run modern cloud applications. Pulumi provides frameworks and libraries to define, deploy, and manage cloud services — from serverless to container to virtual machines — using pure code, for any cloud, with clear collaboration for teams and enterprises.
company.product: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) platform supporting any programming language (Node.js, Python, Go, .NET, Java, YAML) across 170+ cloud providers. Key products include Pulumi IaC, Pulumi ESC (Environments, Secrets & Configuration), Pulumi Insights & Governance, Internal Developer Platforms, and Neo (AI-powered infrastructure engineering agent).

founders.name: Joe Duffy
founders.background: Previously Partner Director of Technical Strategy for Developer Tools at Microsoft. Founder and CEO of Pulumi since its inception.

founders.name: Eric Rudder
founders.background: Previously Executive Vice President of Advanced Strategy at Microsoft.

news.title: Pulumi Introduces AI-Powered Automatic Remediation for Infrastructure Policy Violations
news.summary: Pulumi launched AI-powered automatic remediation capabilities for infrastructure policy violations.

news.title: Introducing Pulumi Neo, the AI-Powered Infrastructure Engineering Agent
news.summary: Pulumi introduced Neo, an AI-powered agent designed for infrastructure engineering and platform engineers.

news.title: Pulumi 2024 Year in Review: Growth, Innovation and Appreciation
news.summary: Pulumi reported over 100M downloads, 167% growth in contributions, and industry-leading innovations in cloud automation for 2024.

news.title: Neo, Next-Gen Policies, and Platform Engineering at Scale
news.summary: Pulumi's 2025 launches include the Neo AI agent for platform engineers, next-gen policy management, IDP, ESC integrations, and IaC enhancements.

news.title: Pulumi Supports Terraform and HCL for IaC
news.summary: Pulumi now supports Terraform, OpenTofu, and HCL alongside Pulumi IaC, removing a long-standing barrier for users migrating or working across toolchains.
